consumer: frontend reference recovery, tests, NamedShape metadata
semantics: Preserves Projection LinkSubList source endpoint identity within one recompute request.
acceptance_rule: Every projected target with provenance must trace to a projection item or carry a diagnostic explaining why not.

consumer: cad-core named_shapes response and downstream reference update logic
semantics: Request-local source-to-target provenance event for generated/modified/split/recovered subshapes.
acceptance_rule: Event is valid if source and target endpoints are request-local and evidence names the ProjectOnSurface stage.

consumer: C5-M9 edge/wire focused tests and frontend stable ref repair
semantics: Records edge and wire fragment ownership for ProjectOnSurface output edges.
non_evidence: output EdgeN order alone, bbox, topology count
acceptance_rule: Focused tests assert projection item index and fragment index for split wires.

consumer: face rebuild stable naming and reference recovery
semantics: Records which source face/wire produced rebuilt face wires and child edges.
non_evidence: face order or wire count alone
acceptance_rule: Focused tests assert outer/inner wire ownership and mapper history diagnostic status.

consumer: compound child selection and offset-aware reference recovery
semantics: Records source ownership across height extrusion, filtering, compound child placement and offset.
non_evidence: persistent native ElementMap cache, full BREP transport
acceptance_rule: Focused tests assert height solid id, compound child ownership and pre-offset child id.

semantics: Invalid Projection / SupportFace failures are request-local diagnostics, not source-to-target provenance.
acceptance_rule: Diagnostics must locate property/target/subname where the request made that available.
